hints.title: Port Transition Cost
hints.text: A consecutive delivery run from box j to box i requires 2 trips plus the number of port changes within boxes[j..i].

hints.title: Prefix Sum Formulation
hints.text: Let diff[k] = 1 if port[k] differs from port[k-1] else 0. Then trip cost for chunk j to i is 2 + prefix_diff[i] - prefix_diff[j].

hints.title: Sliding Window Optimization
hints.text: Optimize dp[i] = 2 + prefix_diff[i] + min(dp[j] - prefix_diff[j]) using a monotonic queue or sliding window.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic O(n^2) DP times out for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic sliding window reduces DP transitions from O(n) to amortized O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes port transition cost structure and optimizes 1D DP with sliding window.
